content_of_post_to_comment: I read somewhere a theory that villains always have PhDs: Dr. Frankenstein, Dr. Doofenshmirtz, Dr. Octopus, Dr. Doom. Meanwhile, the good guys stop at a Master’s: Master Splinter, Master Roshi, Master Yoda, suggesting that a PhD corrupts the soul, and I can’t stop thinking about it.
comment: Maybe the PhD isn't the villain marker so much as the gap between knowledge and wisdom. The trope asks whether mastery without humility turns curiosity into control.
